Supreme Court denies Asaram bail, considers medical condition

The Supreme Court has rejected a bail plea by Asaram in a 2013 rape case. While denying interim bail on medical grounds, the court indicated it would consider his health if it deteriorates significantly. The court also issued a notice to the Rajasthan government seeking its response on Asaram's plea challenging a High Court judgment.
